target.statement: SCMoE improves Mixtral 8x7B accuracy on GSM8K from 61.79 (greedy) to 66.94

compute.basis: Requires running Mixtral 8x7B (~47B params) inference over 1319 GSM8K test questions with two forward passes per token (top-2 and rank-2 routing); on an 8-core CPU this is roughly 100x slower than the paper's 4xA100 setup, making it infeasible within hours.

blockers: Mixtral 8x7B is a ~47B parameter model requiring ~90GB in fp16, far exceeding 16GB RAM
No GPU available; CPU inference of a 47B MoE model is prohibitively slow
Code repo may not include exact evaluation scripts/configs for reproducing Table 1
title: Unchosen Experts Can Contribute Too: Unleashing MoE Models' Power by Self-Contrast
